name: hip_stem_micromotion
description: Winkler-foundation interface micromotion reference (press-fit femoral stem screening).

model.note: Loads span stair-climb peak (~3x BW = 2.2 kN for 75 kg) with margin.

metrics.name: micromotion_monotone_in_load
metrics.assert: delta(4000 N) > delta(2000 N) > delta(500 N)

metrics.name: 2000n_micromotion_um
metrics.note: delta = (0.3*2000/800 + 0.1*0.5*2000/800) / 5 / 1000 mm = 2.75e-2 mm; check against crate formula

notes: Thresholds follow the workspace convention: <50 um primary stability, <150 um osseointegration, above = fibrous fixation risk.
Stress-shielding companion metric: Engh-style 1 - SED_implant/SED_intact per Gruen zone (crate test covers the severe-shielding flag).
